description: Bug report from a user of humanize: humanize.naturalsize(999999) returns "1000.0 kB". A file manager showing that label next to "1.0 MB" for a slightly larger file confuses users. Find the problem and fix it. Change src/humanize/ only.
environment: Python >= 3.13 stdlib; base tree = python-humanize 823ad60^ (src, tests, LICENCE, pyproject, README, .gitignore) plus src/humanize/_version.py (generated at build time by hatch-vcs in the real package; git-ignored) and the task-owned helper bench_fixtures/hz.py; no repository history; the project's own test suite needs pytest, which is not installed
visible_checks: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import humanize; print(humanize.naturalsize(1500))" (from the workspace root; pytest is not available)
provenance: real fix: python-humanize commit 823ad60 (Fix naturalsize() rounding rollover at unit boundaries, #329, 2026-06-30); reference/good.patch is that commit's src diff; symptom-only description (default format, decimal units); hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark (2026-10-13): the rollover must follow the requested format's rounding (no rollover at %.3f, rollover at 999500 with %.0f) and apply to binary, GNU and negative sizes; other reference patches built by build_task.py. Public repository: contamination possible
